description:
Latest trade price for a selected market, plus aggregate market cap and 24h volume. Pass quote_token and market_data_venue together to honor a requested exchange. When omitted, selects a supported market and returns its quote and venue. Report the returned venue and quote; disclose price_as_of and price_stale. Use it when the user asks what an asset is doing now, or when a live price is needed to ground a recommendation. It is a spot reading from an external API and is rate limited, so call it once per asset and reuse the answer.

[Access: pay 0.005 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

market_data_venue.description: Exact venue of the requested market.

provider.description: Optional upstream override; omitted uses the existing server default.

quote_token.description: Quote currency of the requested market.

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

name: get_market_data
